Enterprise Edition.note: Product name; existing strings occasionally show 'Enterprise editie' but keep the English edition name.

Channels.note: Product name, stays English; the common noun 'channel' is 'kanaal'.

LDAP.note: Also AD/LDAP; never translate, per dutch-rules.md (product/protocol name).

SSO.note: Per dutch-rules.md render spelled-out form as 'Single Sign-On (SSO)'; 'vereenvoudigde authenticatie' is not allowed.

Gossip.note: Protocol name; the Weblate glossary row 'Praatjes' is a mistranslation — keep English.

System Console.note: Majority rendering (28 vs 18 for 'Systeem console'); capitalize 'Systeemconsole' when used as a menu/UI-area name per dutch-rules.md capitalization rule.

marketplace.note: Per dutch-rules.md and Weblate glossary; 'Plugin Marketplace' = 'Plugin marktplaats'.

post.note: Per dutch-rules.md 'post' is an anglicism; use 'bericht'. Use 'publiceren' only for system/integration posts, 'versturen' for user messages.

thread.note: Consistently 'draadje' (89 of 92 occurrences); plural 'draadjes'. Do not use 'discussie' or keep English.

reply.note: Noun 'antwoord'; verb 'antwoorden'. Per dutch-rules.md you 'verzendt' (send) a reply.

direct message.note: Existing usage is split between 'privé-bericht' (majority, matches dutch-rules.md) and 'direct bericht'/'rechtstreeks bericht'; keep 'privé-bericht' and the derived 'privé-berichtkanaal'.

notification.note: Per dutch-rules.md; put 'melding' last in compounds: e-mailmelding, pushmelding, bureaubladmelding. Avoid 'notificatie' (legacy inconsistency).

bookmark.note: Noun; verb phrase 'een bladwijzer toevoegen'. 'Channel bookmark' = 'kanaalbladwijzer'.

saved messages.note: Verb 'save' in this feature = 'bewaren' (exception to the general 'Opslaan' preference, matches existing UI).

emoji.note: Per dutch-rules.md and majority usage (63 vs 33); 'emoji' also occurs — prefer 'emoticon' for consistency. Plural 'emoticons'.

reaction.note: Plural 'reacties'; verb 'reageren'. Distinct from a reply ('antwoord') per dutch-rules.md.

do not disturb.note: Capitalized 'Niet storen' as a menu item; keep 'DND' abbreviation only in technical contexts.

out of office.note: Existing UI keeps the English phrase ('Out of office' in webapp/mobile status menus); keep for consistency. 'Afwezig van kantoor' would be the translated alternative.

guest.note: Majority in-product rendering; dutch-rules.md prefers 'gastgebruiker', which also appears in admin screens — both are in use, prefer 'gast' in short UI labels and 'gastgebruiker' when disambiguation from a visitor is needed.

sign in.note: Use for both 'sign in' and 'log in' (majority; 'inloggen' occurs occasionally). Imperative button: 'Aanmelden'.

sign out.note: Use for both 'sign out' and 'log out', per Weblate glossary ('Log Out' = 'Afmelden').

join.note: For channels/teams: 'lid worden (van)'. For calls use 'deelnemen (aan)'.

unarchive.note: Existing UI buttons use 'Dearchiveren'; the system message uses 'haalde het kanaal terug uit het archief' — both acceptable, prefer 'dearchiveren' in labels.

mute.note: For channel notifications; 'unmute' = 'niet langer dempen' (webapp) / 'dempen uitschakelen' (calls).

favorite.note: Noun/adjective 'favoriet' (plural 'Favorieten' for the sidebar category); verb 'markeren als favoriet', 'unfavorite' = 'verwijderen uit favorieten'.

slash command.note: Majority rendering (15 vs 9); dutch-rules.md prefers 'slash-commando'. Existing usage is inconsistent (slashopdracht, slash-opdracht, slash-commando) — standardize on 'slash-opdracht'.

webhook.note: Kept in English per Weblate glossary; plural 'webhooks'.

trigger word.note: Per dutch-rules.md; existing usage is inconsistent ('activeer-woord', 'trigger woord') — standardize on 'triggerwoord'.

permission.note: Plural 'rechten', per dutch-rules.md ('Rechten heeft de voorkeur'); avoid 'machtigingen'/'permissies'/'toestemmingen' which appear inconsistently in older strings.

scheme.note: Permission scheme = '(toestemmings)schema'; existing strings mostly use plain 'schema'. For URL scheme use 'URL-protocol' per dutch-rules.md.

seat.note: Billing strings translate 'seats' as 'gebruikers' (e.g. '{num} seats' = '{num} gebruikers'); use 'gebruikerslicentie' only if disambiguation is required.

trial.note: 'Free trial' = 'gratis proefperiode'. Avoid 'probeerversie'/'proefversie' which appear sporadically.

invitation.note: Plural 'uitnodigingen'; e-mail invitations = 'e-mailuitnodigingen' (note 'e-mail' spelling per dutch-rules.md).

attachment.note: Plural 'bijlagen'; verb 'attach' for files = 'toevoegen'/'bijvoegen' per dutch-rules.md, 'koppelen' otherwise.

public channel.note: Usage is split between 'publiek kanaal' (majority, 12) and 'openbaar kanaal' (9); standardize on 'publiek kanaal'.

private channel.note: Majority spelling (37 vs 15 for 'privékanaal'); keep the hyphenated form for consistency.

channel header.note: Existing usage is inconsistent (kanaalkoptekst, hoofding, koptekst, kop); server strings mostly use 'kanaalkoptekst' — standardize on that; avoid the Flemish 'hoofding'.

channel purpose.note: Existing strings consistently use 'doel'/'kanaaldoel'; dutch-rules.md suggests 'beschrijving' in this context but repo usage wins.

message priority.note: Also rendered 'prioriteit van het bericht' in picker headers; use 'berichtprioriteit' as compound term.

urgent.note: Label 'DRINGEND' in caps context; 'urgente meldingen' also occurs but prefer 'dringend' (majority).

recap.note: Existing recap feature strings use 'samenvatting'; disambiguate as 'AI-samenvatting' only if plain 'samenvatting' is ambiguous in context.

agent.note: AI feature; 'AI agent' = 'AI-agent', plural 'AI-agenten'. Keep product name 'Agents' in English where used as a product.

burn-on-read.note: Webapp UI uses 'verbrand-na-lezen berichten'; some server strings keep English 'burn-on-read' — prefer the Dutch form in user-facing text.

magic link.note: Majority rendering; 'Magic Link' kept in English in a few strings — prefer 'magische link'.

personal access token.note: 'Token' stays untranslated per dutch-rules.md; avoid Weblate glossary's 'toegangsbewijs' (not used in product strings).

nickname.note: Existing UI uses 'roepnaam'; keep 'Nickname' in AD/LDAP-attribute admin contexts where the technical attribute name is meant.

collapsed reply threads.note: Majority mobile rendering; 'ingeklapte antwoorddraadjes' also occurs — prefer the shorter form.

data retention.note: 'Data retention policy' = 'gegevensbewaarbeleid' (majority); avoid 'dataretentie' which appears sporadically.

compliance export.note: Majority webapp rendering; 'compliance export' also kept English in some strings. Dutch-rules.md renders 'Beta' contexts as 'Experimenteel'.

attribute.note: Plural 'attributen'; 'kenmerk' also occurs in ABAC strings — prefer 'attribuut' for the profile/access-control field.

onboarding.note: Per Weblate glossary; existing strings are inconsistent (verwelkoming, onboarding, introductie) — standardize on 'verwelkoming'.

Town Square.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n.

Off-Topic.note: Existing server translation keeps the English channel name.

read-only.note: Predicative use: 'alleen lezen' ('Kanaal is alleen lezen').
